chunks: Sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah is sufficient as a disposer of affairs?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this declaration within the doctrine of *Tawhid* and divine guardianship (*Wilayah*), emphasizing that true sufficiency (*Kifayah*) is exclusive to Allah amidst the trials of the Imams. This statement serves as a cornerstone for Shia theological resilience, linking reliance on God directly to the acceptance of divine decree and the continuity of prophetic guidance.
